title: Case in Queue | 14 Days Exhausted | No Answer | Agent Review
description:
Extension of TC_072. ALL disruption codes are missing and after polling Trip Tracer daily for 14 days, the data NEVER arrives. System exhausts the 14-day polling window and routes the case to manual agent handling. Validates the end-of-polling escalation path � confirms that the system doesn't poll indefinitely and has a definitive cutoff.

PNR: Single passenger (Ga�tan Rivard), 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ. Itinerary: Scheduled arrival 14:00, Actual arrival 18:00 (4hr delay per flight status). All disruption codes: MISSING � never logged by any station. DDS polling: System has polled Trip Tracer daily for 14 consecutive days. Day 14: Data still not available. Polling window: EXHAUSTED.
